tasks.title: Enable CAS-bound replanning of human-resolved failed tasks
tasks.objective: Implement and test a failed-task replan transition that is authorized by the recorded human resolution, binds status/attempt/revision/fingerprint/feature generation, atomically activates an immutable packet revision, preserves attempt and authorization history and legacy bytes, and leaves the task failed for ordinary claim/start.
tasks.test_seam: Add failing behavioral tests before implementation: missing or mismatched human-resolution evidence; stale status, attempt, revision, fingerprint or feature generation; completed task; competing request; and a passing failed-task transition proving atomic active revision selection, byte-identical legacy packet, unchanged attempts/authorization history, then normal claim/start binding to the new revision.

tasks.title: Adversarially evaluate failed-task replan lifecycle safety
tasks.objective: Independently verify every acceptance criterion, including the state replacement boundary, retry authorization invariants, crash behavior, stale/concurrent request rejection, and claim/start binding to the active immutable revision.
tasks.test_seam: Fresh-context adversarial review of the accepted spec against implementation and tests; explicitly attempt state mutation through stale human-resolution evidence, generation drift, concurrent replans, and failures between immutable publication and state replacement.
